journal_lines: Slimes in the low ground. Messy.
The small ones after the big one. Tedious.
Big slime. Then medium. Then small. Then done.
Slime chunk. The floor was covered.
The noise of the bouncing was the warning.
They follow sound. Made noise elsewhere first.
Can't hurt them from above. Stood level. Worked.
Three large ones in a single chamber. Methodical.
The smaller the slime the harder to land a hit. Ended them all.
Green everywhere. At least it washed off.
Slime in the low ground after rain. Extra bouncing.
Cornered one. Cornered all the pieces.
The floor bounced slightly. Tested it. Realized. Left.
